name: 终极地狱-指间MUD版
english_description: Introduces itself in-game as 'No Escape From Hell' (the archive's own title is 'Ultimate Hell — Fingertip MUD Edition'). Part of the ES II to XKX to 'Hell' branch of the engine family, and a sister build of this collection's zjdyaryl ('Ai Ruo You Lan'), sharing the same 'Hell' engine core with an added layer supporting the 'Fingertip MUD' mobile-client protocol. Not the same game as zhongjidiyu, another archive in this collection that also happens to carry 'Ultimate Hell' in its name.
